offering_description.value: Provides temperature-controlled and dry truckload freight transportation for shippers across North America, using company-owned tractors and trailers, dedicated fleet contracts and intermodal rail combined with trucking. Customers are mainly manufacturers and retailers that ship food and consumer goods.

primary_services.value: temperature-controlled truckload transportation; dedicated contract carriage; intermodal freight; dry van truckload transportation

customer_segment.value: B2B: shippers of food, beverages, consumer goods and retail products

end_markets.value: food and beverage; retail; consumer packaged goods; manufacturing

revenue_model.value: service fees: per-mile and per-load charges for hauling freight; project or contract: dedicated fleet contracts with shippers

value_chain_position.value: service provider: takes in freight from shippers and delivers it to receivers for shipper customers; asset operator: owns and runs a large tractor and trailer fleet used for freight hauling

geography_served.value: North America: continental United States, plus cross-border freight to Canada and Mexico

specialization.value: related lines: temperature-controlled truckload, dedicated contract carriage and intermodal services sharing shippers and fleet operations

distribution_channels.value: direct sales: direct contracts with shippers and manufacturers

regulatory_exposure.value: medium: US DOT and FMCSA rules on driver hours of service, vehicle safety and interstate motor carrier operations

divestiture_lines: P2.40: MARTEN TRANSPORT ANNOUNCES SALE OF ASSETS RELATED TO INTERMODAL BUSINESS
